aboutGame.title: What is Bunny Mummy?
paragraphs: Bunny Mummy is the spooky-cute mashup of a soft rabbit and an ancient bandaged mummy. In game it arrives as a limited-time collectible - a wrapped-rabbit skin, a matching pet, or a display figure - while in the wider community the same name describes a mother rabbit and the litter of kits she raises.

Because Bunny Mummy is tied to limited windows and rotating shops instead of a permanent shelf slot, availability and value shift fast. This wiki tracks where the look appears, how to unlock or earn it, what each bundle contains, and how to style it, so you never miss a reset or fall for a fake code.

modules.name: Bunny Mummy Beginner Guide
modules.description: New player guidance: what Bunny Mummy is, the first steps to unlock it, early tips, and the decisions that matter most in your first session.

highlights.detail: Identify which Bunny Mummy you are chasing first - the wrapped-rabbit skin, the matching pet, or a physical plush - because each one has a different unlock path.
Check the official event calendar and note the exact start and end dates so you never miss the window.
Bank event currency early instead of grinding during the final days, when prices and competition both spike.
Complete the quest chain in order, because side objectives often gate the final Bunny Mummy reward.
Verify every code or trade through official sources before you commit anything of value.

highlights.detail: Hold jump for a longer, riskier arc; releasing mid-air costs you distance and control.

highlights.label: Wrap-Dash
highlights.detail: Direction plus dash to cross hazards fast - just do not dash into a wall of bandages.

highlights.label: Slide / Tuck
highlights.detail: Crouch while moving to slip under obstacles; commit only when you can cancel before a hazard.

highlights.label: Unwrap-Pull
highlights.detail: Interact near an anchor point within a very tight window - time it and the run stays clean.

items.question: What is Bunny Mummy?
items.answer: Bunny Mummy is a spooky-cute character that fuses a soft rabbit with an ancient bandaged mummy. In game it appears as a limited-time collectible - a wrapped-rabbit skin, a matching pet, or a display figure - and in the wider community the name also describes a mother rabbit and her litter of kits.

items.question: How do I get Bunny Mummy?
items.answer: Work the legitimate routes: claim the seasonal event reward, buy it from a rotating shop with banked currency, finish the event quest chain, or trade for it after the window closes. Confirm which version of Bunny Mummy you are chasing first, then follow the route that matches.

items.question: Are Bunny Mummy codes real?
items.answer: Most secret Bunny Mummy code lists are fake or expired. Treat any code that asks for your login, payment, or a survey as a scam, and confirm rewards only through official channels.

items.question: How much does the Bunny Mummy bundle cost?
items.answer: A full Bunny Mummy bundle groups the main skin or pet with matching accessories and small extras for better value than buying each piece separately. Prices are lowest while the event is live and peak in the weeks right after it ends.

items.question: When will Bunny Mummy return?
items.answer: Limited-time collectibles rotate on the developer's own schedule and are rarely announced far ahead. Check the shop every reset, follow official channels, and track community shop-sighting threads to catch the next Bunny Mummy window.
